title: Figure 6: Lightcraft undergoing horizontal guide-wire flight test (laboratory still)
description: Blurry, blue-tinted video still of a laboratory setup showing the circular rear of a Lightcraft vehicle on a guide wire beside test apparatus. Caption: "Figure 6. Lightcraft Undergoing Horizontal Guide-Wire Flight Test (courtesy of F. Mead, AFRL/PRSP, Edwards AFB, CA)." Below it begins a 'Summary of Technical Performance and Benefits' listing single-stage-to-orbit and launch-cost claims.
